summary: This is an 8-K filed by Intapp, Inc. regarding a Third Amended and Restated Registration Rights Agreement with its investor (Anderson Investments and its affiliate Aranda) and John Hall. The amendment extends the agreement until the investor holds less than 5% of outstanding stock and adds Aranda as a party. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is involved. It is a routine contractual update to registration rights, not a special situation.
